headline: Mangalam Worldwide Limited Board approves issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures up to ₹100 crore on private placement basis
sum: Mangalam Worldwide Limited's board has approved the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) up to ₹100 crore via private placement, with a Debenture Committee constituted to determine terms and conditions.
implication: Private NCD issuances bypass public offer regulatory friction but require careful drafting of terms (coupon, tenure, security/covenants) and SEBI compliance under the SEBI Debenture Trustee Regulations — the Committee's charter and board-level governance framework will be critical to the documentation phase.
detail: The board meeting held on 24 February 2026 approved the capital raise via NCDs on a private placement basis, capping the issuance at ₹100 crore. A Debenture Committee has been constituted to finalise the terms, conditions, and mechanics of the offering. The company has made the mandatory disclosure to NSE. The structure avoids the cost and timeline of a public offering but subjects the debentures to SEBI's debenture regulations, secured/unsecured status determination, and creditor protection norms under the Companies Act.
